items.summary: Brighton continued their impressive Conference League campaign with a 1-0 victory over Getafe, with Malick Yalcouye scoring the winner as the Seagulls maintained their perfect defensive record in the competition with three consecutive clean sheets.

source.title: Hurzeler hopes to fulfil dreams of Brighton fans after Conference League win over Getafe

items.summary: Sitting third in the Premier League with 19 points and the division's highest goal tally of 24, the Seagulls face Brentford at the Amex Stadium on Sunday, where manager Fabian Hurzeler has warned his side to be ready for a physical battle.

source.title: Andrews urges Brentford to 'bring our A game' against Brighton

items.summary: Liverpool are reportedly eyeing moves for Brighton's standout performers, with goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen and defender Luka Vušković both attracting interest from the Anfield club as potential future signings.

source.title: Transfer Rumors: Van Dijk Wants Barcelona Move; Man Utd to Offload Dalot
